description: Fistweaver-flavored melee hybrid - autoattacks and Justice/Glorious Execution build Solar Power toward a Dawn window that auto-crits Horusath Blast and unlocks Sunslam.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Judgement Day, Justice, Gavel of Wrath, Sunslam, Vow of Dawn confirmed via screenshot as class-wide/shared). Real mechanic per handoff: Valkyr's Grip enables dual-wielding two-handed maces/swords/polearms (per Kyle's direction), Vow of Radiance transforms into Vow of the Valkyr at Lvl 15, autos + melee-damage stacks (Sunwalker) build Solar Power that culminates in Champion of the Sun into Judgement Day's disorient-and-detonate.

nodes.name: Valorous Champion
nodes.description: Grants Attack Power and spell hit rating from Strength at 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Level 20 Passive. AP + spell hit rating from Strength.'

nodes.name: Angelic
nodes.description: Increases your chance to dodge by 1% per rank and reduces the duration of stuns against you by 5% per rank.

nodes.name: Solar Crusader
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Dawn by 4% per rank. Casting Dawn floods you with 3 Solar Power.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Dawn's damage + healing.'

nodes.name: Valkyr's Grip
nodes.description: Enables dual-wielding two-handed maces, swords, or polearms, and increases hit chance while dual-wielding.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed, per Kyle's direction: 'Enables dual-wield or two-hand mace/sword/polearm in each hand; boosts hit chance.' Valkyrie's signature two-hander dual-wield mechanic.

nodes.name: Valkyrie
nodes.description: Transforms Vow of Radiance into Vow of the Valkyr.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 15 Passive. Transforms Vow of Radiance into Vow of the Valkyr.'

nodes.name: Champion of the Sun
nodes.description: Learn Champion of the Sun, empowering autoattacks with bonus Holy damage for a window.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Boosts auto attacks with bonus Holy damage, for a window.' Valkyrie's real burst-window opener.

nodes.name: Glorious Execution
nodes.description: Learn Glorious Execution, a dual-weapon strike that regenerates mana equal to a percentage of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: 'Strike with both weapons dealing Weapon Damage plus 13 Physical damage and regenerate mana equal to 5% of the damage dealt.'

nodes.name: Sunsworn
nodes.description: Increases your Physical damage by 3% per rank. Your weapon swings have a 10% chance per rank to grant 2 Solar Power.

nodes.name: Sun's Gift
nodes.description: Horusath Blast deals bonus Attack-Power-scaling damage and grants allies Replenishment.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 30 Passive. Horusath Blast deals bonus AP-scaling damage + grants allies Replenishment.'

nodes.name: Divine Retribution
nodes.description: Banks a percentage of damage dealt to a target, unleashing it as AoE Holy damage after a delay.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Banks 25% of damage dealt to a target, unleashing it as AoE Holy damage after a delay.' Valkyrie's real stored-damage burst payoff.

nodes.name: Valkyr's Calling
nodes.description: Leap at a target, immune to physical and spell damage in flight, then land for AoE Holy damage.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Leaps at a target, immune to physical + spell during flight; lands for AoE Holy damage.' Valkyrie's real escape-and-reset capstone.

nodes.name: Judgement Day
nodes.description: Learn Judgement Day, an AoE disorient. Damage dealt ends the effect but increases their damage taken from your next hit.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot (class-wide entry): AoE disorient with damage-taken bonus. Valkyrie's real Repentance-into-finisher setup.

nodes.name: March of the Valkyr
nodes.description: Grants the party and raid a damage buff, and increases your parry chance. Does not stack with similar effects.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid damage buff (no stacking with similar); boosts your parry chance.'

nodes.name: Pendant of the Sun
nodes.description: Refreshes Dawn's duration and charges.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Refreshes Dawn's duration + charges.' Keeps the Dawn empowered window rolling.

nodes.name: It's Always Sunny
nodes.description: Dawn activation reduces the cooldowns of Radiance, Valkyr's Calling, and Sunslam.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Dawn activation reduces Radiance/Valkyr's Calling/Sunslam cooldowns.'

nodes.name: Holy Giant
nodes.description: Your damaging casts have a 20% chance to make you a giant of light for 2 turns, increasing Strength by 10% and reducing Physical damage taken by 5%.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 50 Passive. Doubles Vow of the Valkyr's effectiveness.' Valkyrie's real Solar Power engine capstone.

nodes.name: Solar Might
nodes.description: Increases Strength and Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Solar Might (T) - Boosts Strength + Intellect.'

nodes.name: Warrior's Light
nodes.description: Increases Sunflare and Justice damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Sunflare/Justice damage.'

nodes.name: Path To Glory
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Justice and Glorious Execution by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Reduces Justice/Glorious Execution cooldown.'

nodes.name: Knight of Dawn
nodes.description: Glorious Execution has a 5% chance per rank to immediately strike again at no cost.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Glorious Execution chance to strike an extra time.'

nodes.name: Light of the Sun
nodes.description: Taking damage has a 15% chance per rank to restore 30 health and raise your parry chance by 5% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Parrying restores health + boosts next parry chance.'

nodes.name: Vindicator
nodes.description: Glorious Execution ignores the target's Armor while Vow of the Valkyr is active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Glorious Execution ignores target's armor while Vow of the Valkyr active.'

nodes.name: Impartial
nodes.description: Increases Strength, maximum Mana, and expertise by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Strength + max mana + expertise.'

nodes.name: Scrying Orb
nodes.description: Learn Scrying Orb, summoning a controllable scrying orb for reconnaissance.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Summons a controllable scrying orb.'

nodes.name: Valkyrie's Watch
nodes.description: Reduces damage that would drop you below 35% health, and reduces damage taken while below it, by 3%.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Reduces damage that would drop you below 35% health, and damage taken below it.'

nodes.name: Faith Militant
nodes.description: Increases your attack speed by 1% per rank. Killing an enemy raises your attack speed by a further 15% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Sunsworn also boosts melee attack speed per stack.'
